cli.config_help.open: Open the configuration file in the default editor
cli.config_help.edit: Edit a specific configuration value in the config file
cli.config_help.edit_key: Configuration key to update (e.g., hosting, model_name, conversation_length, detail_length, max_learnings_history, auto_save_conversation)
cli.config_help.edit_value: New value for the configuration key (type is automatically converted based on the key)
cli.config_help.list: List available configuration options and their descriptions
cli.config_help.instructions: Show which custom-instruction files a session assembles, in order (paths and sizes only, never their contents)
cli.config_help.instructions_description: Show which custom-instruction files a session assembles, in order, with the size each contributed and whether it was collapsed as a duplicate, truncated, or overlaps an earlier source. Paths and sizes only, never the contents.
